name: vix_adjusted_mean_reversion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms (pension funds, FIIs executing large program orders) aggressively fade intraday deviations from session VWAP, but their activation threshold scales with current VIX. In low-VIX regimes (< 14), NIFTY's compressed realized vol makes even a 20-30 spot point deviation from VWAP statistically anomalous (z-score ~1.0), triggering immediate algo-driven fading within 30-60 seconds. In high-VIX regimes (> 20), those same institutions require 60-80 spot point deviations (z-score ~2.5+) before fading because intraday noise is genuinely wider and smaller deviations are not statistically significant. By scaling the entry z-score threshold dynamically with VIX — entering only when the deviation is anomalous relative to the current volatility regime — we isolate the conditions where the reverting institutional force is strong enough to produce a measurable 30-90 second bounce on the index.
core_signal_oneliner: VWAP z-score deviation fade where the entry threshold scales dynamically with current India VIX level
